_note: Bendike-written summaries for the Squirrel TV library, keyed by YouTube id. One line each, saying what the video gives you and who it is for. Never copy Squirrel's own description in here: theirs is written to sell their suits, ours is written for someone deciding what to watch. Instructional BASE videos say plainly that they are not a substitute for training. The seed in seed-squirrel-tv.ts fails if a video reaches it without an entry here.
